messages:
Sam (People Ops): Short update: three small policy tweaks effective July 1. 1) PTO accrual for first-year hires increases to 1.5 days/month. 2) Emergency caregiver leave expanded to 8 weeks paid. 3) Travel exception: single-trip spends under $2k can use manager + finance fast-track. Also: mandatory Code of Conduct micro-training due July 15. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/policies/people-updates. React :white_check_mark: when read.

Ivy (Eng): Does PTO change affect offers already sent?

Sam (People Ops): No, offers already accepted remain as-is. New offers will use the updated accrual.

Mark (Ops): For the fast-track, are team retreats covered?

Sam (People Ops): Retreats > $2k per person need program approval. Small local team meetups under $2k are fine via fast-track.

compliance-bot: ACTION: Code of Conduct micro-training assigned to all employees. Complete by July 15. Completion tracked automatically.

Sam (People Ops): One-pager incoming and pinned in #people-ops. DM me for special exceptions. Thanks!
